name: Ruins of Stardust
summary: South of Astranaar, corruption from Felwood reaches the island sanctuary at the Ruins of Stardust. Bog beasts prowl its fallen stones, while healing shrubs still grow among them.

sections.title: A Blighted Sanctuary
sections.body: South of Astranaar, you find the Ruins of Stardust on a lone island. The night elves once revered this holy place. Now demonic rot spreads south from Felwood, turning the water sickly yellow-green, as it does at nearby Iris Lake. The corruption has twisted local plant life into hostile bog beasts. They prowl the fallen stones, warped by the tainted water.

sections.title: The Enduring Stardust
sections.body: Stardust shrubs still bloom among the ruins, untouched by corruption in the soil and along the shore. Their leaves and blossoms can cleanse and heal. Shamans, herbalists, and local night elf defenders seek them for remedies against Ashenvale's encroaching decay.

faq.q: What were the Ruins of Stardust originally used for?
faq.answer: The night elves once kept the Ruins of Stardust as sacred ground. Its marble pillars and lakeside perch offered a quiet place for reverence before demonic corruption took root in the forest.

faq.q: Why is the water around the island discolored?
faq.answer: Demonic corruption flows from Felwood's blighted peaks into Ashenvale's waterways and taints the lake. The water turns murky yellow-green and disturbs its natural balance.

faq.q: What makes the stardust shrubs special?
faq.answer: Stardust shrubs remain pure in soil soaked by demonic runoff. They resist the surrounding taint and can restore and heal, making them valuable in cleansing rites.
Large, corrupted bog beasts wander the island. Tainted water has warped these nature elementals from peaceful forest guardians into aggressive threats that lumber through the shallows.

angles.text: As a shaman, you can use uncorrupted stardust as a cleansing reagent in spiritual trials, including the Call of Water trials to master the restorative elements.
As a night elf, you see a former sanctuary falling to Felwood's slow, putrid runoff. Its fate reminds you of the struggle to protect Ashenvale from enduring demonic corruption.
